mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_seo_notification_log(provider_code, route_path, canonical_url, change_type, status, next_retry_at) VALUES (#{providerCode}, #{routePath}, #{canonicalUrl}, #{changeType}, 'PENDING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id, provider_code, route_path, canonical_url, change_type, status, attempt_count, next_retry_at FROM sr_seo_notification_log WHERE attempt_count < 5 AND ( (status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND next_retry_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND last_attempt_at < DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE))) ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_seo_notification_log SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_attempt_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt_count < 5 AND ( (status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND next_retry_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND last_attempt_at < DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)))
UPDATE sr_seo_notification_log SET status = 'SUCCESS', http_status = #{httpStatus}, last_error = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sr_seo_notification_log SET status = 'FAILED', http_status = #{httpStatus}, last_error = #{error}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt} WHERE id = #{id}
